_note: Durable, machine-readable operator action matrix (contract/OPERATOR.md section 4). This file is the normative source for the per-action security fields; contract/OPERATOR.md inlines a human-readable copy and points here. Freeze gate: server/tests/test_operator_vocab_freeze.py pins every field below AND enforces JSON<->Markdown field agreement, failing on any mutation. Growing or changing this matrix follows the AUTH.md section 11 promotion ritual (amend this file, the OPERATOR.md table, and the gate in one PR).

operator.worker_submit_job.precondition: no production credential in job env (structural); disposable workspace
operator.worker_submit_job.reversal: cancel job; workspace is disposable and destroyed on completion

operator.worker_cancel_job.precondition: job exists and is owned by the principal

operator.repo_propose_change.precondition: branch namespace operator/<subject>/<uuid>; base SHA named
operator.repo_propose_change.reversal: delete the operator/<subject>/<uuid> branch; never touches main

operator.tenant_agent_pause.precondition: tenant exists; current enabled-state revision named

operator.tenant_agent_resume.precondition: tenant exists; current disabled-state revision named

operator.tenant_overlay_set.reversal: restore the prior overlay recorded on the authority receipt

operator.worker_credential_rotate.reversal: re-issue the previous scope (not the previous secret)

operator.external_write.precondition: allowlisted destination; scoped short-lived token handle
operator.external_write.reversal: per-adapter documented reversal, or the adapter does not ship

operator.stage_release_candidate.precondition: exact source SHA named; candidate immutable; staging only
operator.stage_release_candidate.reversal: staging auto-rollback to the previous ECS task-def revision
